Orthodontics & Oral Surgery Specialist care under one roof in Ashmun

A specialist you can plan your treatment around.

Dr. Mahmoud AbdelAaty is an orthodontics and oral & maxillofacial specialist practicing at EverWhite Dental Clinic in Ashmun. Patients come to him for long-term treatment plans — braces, implants, and full smile restorations — not just single visits.

Every case on this page is a real patient treated at the clinic, documented from first visit to final result.

  • Orthodontics & braces
  • Cosmetic dentistry
  • Dental implants
  • Root canal treatment
  • Zirconia & E-max crowns
  • Oral & maxillofacial surgery

Treatment built around your case, not a checklist.
